svg.title: Interpreted sign panel silhouette
svg.desc: Reconstructed from reusable PofBC elements: twelve unaltered Spirit of BC flag paths, committed TeX Gyre Termes Regular glyph outlines with reversible weight and descender adjustments, three new geometric stripe extensions and a white panel. Layout estimated from Bennett-06(1).jpg. The original sign font and paint specification are unverified. No photographic tracing, raster image or font dependency in the master.
